name: Video Gallery
short_desc: Self-hosted video gallery for FPV clips and Instagram downloads with tag filtering, captions, and external links
author: cori
description: Browsable video gallery that scans a directory for video files, extracts metadata via ffprobe, and serves a dark-themed HTML5 grid with inline players, search, sort, and tag/source-type filter pills. Reads SQLite metadata (gallery.db) for captions, Instagram source URLs, source type (saved/liked/viewed/youtube), and 958+ hashtags. Includes watch pages with OpenGraph/Twitter Card tags for share previews, clickable tag chips linking to filtered gallery, and an external links page grouped by domain.

form_fields.label: Refresh Interval (seconds)
form_fields.hint: How often to re-scan the video directory for new files. 300 = 5 min.

form_fields.label: Public Domain
form_fields.hint: Public domain for OpenGraph/Twitter Card URLs (e.g., gallery.407.lol)
